label.purpose: Field labels, step names, and compact supporting text.

shadows.name: transient-menu
shadows.purpose: Lift dropdown menus and popovers above static page surfaces.

components.name: Signup Primary Button
components.description: The full-width primary action at the end of the signup form.
components.css: .ds-signup-primary { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #36bff9; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-signup-primary:hover { background: #2aa8e0; } .ds-signup-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(215 20.2% 65.1%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-signup-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-signup-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A single-line field used for name, phone, email, and company details.
components.html: <input class="ds-text-input" type="text" placeholder="First Name" aria-label="First Name" />
components.css: .ds-text-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(214.3 31.8% 91.4%); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #101828; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-text-input::placeholder { color: #667085; opacity: 1; } .ds-text-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(215 20.2% 65.1%); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-text-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Signup Form Card
components.description: The static white container for the enrollment fields.
components.css: .ds-signup-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #eaecf0; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #101828; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-signup-card { padding: 32px; } }

components.name: Progress Step
components.description: A numbered marker and label for the current step in the four-step flow.
components.html: 1. 1Your Info
components.css: .ds-progress { color: #475467; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-progress-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-progress-marker { display: inline-flex; width: 32px; height: 32px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 2px solid #36bff9; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #36bff9; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-progress-label { color: #36bff9; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; } .ds-progress-marker:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #36bff9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Consent Checkbox
components.description: A compact agreement checkbox with adjacent readable consent text.
components.css: .ds-consent { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; color: #475467; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent input { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: #36bff9; } .ds-consent input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(215 20.2% 65.1%); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a clear, professional path through a focused enrollment task. A centered form, visible step progress, and one prominent action keep attention on completing the current step. Inter typography and restrained neutral surfaces support quick scanning without competing with the form.

Brand Blue identifies active progress and primary actions. The Opus logo anchors the white header; its red mark is a supporting brand detail rather than a recurring interface accent. Static surfaces are defined by fine borders, while elevation is reserved for transient menus and popovers.
keyCharacteristics: Professional neutral surfaces with a focused blue action color
Progress indicators make the multi-step flow visible
Borders define static cards and fields; shadows belong to overlays
dos: Do use Brand Blue consistently for the primary action and active or completed progress.
Do keep the logo centered in a clean white header.
Do use fine borders to separate the static form card and fields from the page canvas.
Do keep the step sequence visible while adapting its labels for narrow screens.
donts: Don't use Opus Red as a second primary action color; it is a logo accent in the current system.
Don't add heavy shadows to static cards or form fields.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, display fonts, or extra accent colors that are absent from the incumbent interface.
